system.description: You speak a sentence, and reality bends to obey. The more impossible the wish, the more likely you unravel instead. Whatever the result, roll a d2 afterwards: on a 1, you lose this spell.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you may speak one more sentence.
outcomes.success: Your sentence comes true, as the Dark Master interprets it.
outcomes.failure: Reality obeys only in part, and twists the rest.
outcomes.ruin: Your sentence comes true, but against you. Roll on the Shadowblight table.

outcomeEffects.note: roll a d2 afterwards: on a 1, you lose this spell
